name: Tiffin University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. Tuition $35,700/year (block rate 12-17 credit hours) for 2026-27 from tiffin.edu/tuition; excludes technology fee ($450/yr) and campus services fee ($550/yr). Housing room only from same page: residence hall double (no A/C) $6,200/year, the lowest published on-campus room rate (housing range $6,200-$7,920, meal plans separate).
